Featured Match

The 137 has to do it again

Home
willmoran
0–1 · 77 pts
vs
Away
skoeiboy
1–0 · 138 pts

skoeiboy drew the hardest possible follow-up: the league's high scorer against the manager who has the most reason to want a bounce. willmoran lost his opener 82.60–76.60 to mdropkin, the one man in the twelve with no DPL history, and did it with Isak returning 8.00 and Watkins still on the bench. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall led that side with 18.00, which tells you the top end never arrived. Ice man's problem is different — De Cuyper and Emersonn were worth 50.00 between them in GW1, and neither is priced like that going forward.

vs

bjennings28 scored 100.90 in GW1, the second-highest total in the league, and lost by 36.75 because he ran into skoeiboy's week. Jack Hinshelwood went for 28.50 and James Trafford added 15.00 from goal. erozier begins the defence of his title with a narrower story: 79.40 past Flabiano9's 64.35, Saka and Gvardiol carrying most of it. One of these two is 1-0 on merit and the other is 0-1 on the schedule.
